hero.note: We’re thrilled and counting the days ✨

hero.title: Our Story
hero.lead: When we first met, we never imagined that one day we would live our greatest dream: marriage. The day is getting closer, our hearts beat fast and memories flow of all we have lived and built. It’s beautiful to recall every small piece of our love story.

place.title: The place where it all began
place.lead: Amid lights and songs we met. Among prayers, Sunday hugs and the smiles after church, something simple and strong was born. Here we learned to serve, to believe together, to say “I’m here” for each other. Every time we enter church, we find that first glance again and know that home isn’t just a place: it’s God’s presence and the people beside us.

hero.title: GIFTS
hero.lead: The greatest gift is your presence. 🤍
